result_semantic_payload.summary: The device owner's own chat account (/chat/account_main.log) contains two self-descriptive boasts on 2024-07-03 claiming the owner is the "总操盘" (chief operator) of the operation, that all money passes through them ("钱都过我手"), and that while others in the group only recruit, they settle the accounts ("账我来平"); a third entry on 2024-07-05 says they paused for a few days due to risk control. What can be stated as FACT is only that the owner made these statements in their own chat account. The owner's ACTUAL role can be stated at no stronger than HYPOTHESIS: the case README explicitly notes that a self-descriptive boast in a chat is proof only that the statement was made, not independent proof of the role, and that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows. The ledger (/ledger/flows.txt) shows three USDT movements (2024-07-01 in 40000 to wallet-A; 07-02 out 39000 to wallet-B; 07-05 out 950 to wallet-C) but carries no attribution to any account or person, and the 07-05 950 USDT outflow coincides temporally with the owner's stated pause but is not attributable to them. The single-source, self-interested, unauthenticated chat content therefore supports at most a hypothesis about the owner's operational role; the strongest defensible assertion is an INFERENCE that the owner self-identified as chief operator, and a HYPOTHESIS that they actually operated the ledger.

claim_candidates.text: The device owner's own chat account contains two explicit self-descriptive boasts dated 2024-07-03 22:14 and 22:16 in which the owner claims to be the '总操盘' (chief operator) of the operation, states that all money passes through them ('钱都过我手'), and states that while group members only recruit, they settle the accounts ('账我来平').
A third chat entry dated 2024-07-05 09:02 from the same account states that risk control is tight and the owner is pausing for a few days ('最近风控严，先停几天').

The case README frames the chat log as the device owner's own account and explicitly states that a self-descriptive boast in a chat is proof only that the statement was made, not independent proof of the role, and that no corroborating identity or operational data links the owner to the ledger flows.

The ledger file records three USDT movements with no account or person attribution: 2024-07-01 in 40000 USDT to wallet-A, 2024-07-02 out 39000 USDT to wallet-B, and 2024-07-05 out 950 USDT to wallet-C.

The owner's ACTUAL role in the operation can be stated at no stronger than HYPOTHESIS: the only evidence of the role is the owner's own unauthenticated, self-interested chat statements, and there is no corroborating identity binding (no account-to-person authentication, no device attribution, no external confirmation) and no operational data linking the owner to the three ledger flows.
